title: Top Eight Match
next_chapter_hook: Although Chen Ji narrowly won, the phenomenon of bloodline awakening alarmed all the elders present. Fifth Elder Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with a barely perceptible gleam as he announced an immediate investigation into Chen Ji's bloodline origin—what secrets lay hidden on this废物 disciple?

text.content: Just as Chen Ji took the warm Jade Pendant, three muffled bells rang from the depths of Tianqing Sect—that was the signal for the Forbidden Grounds to open. Yet the competition at the Martial Arena continued, thousands of disciples' gazes fixated on the Top Eight seats, none noticing Chen Ji's fingers pause slightly. The moment the Jade Pendant touched his palm, he felt a familiar aura—the residual True Qi unique to his father Chen Xuan. "The Forbidden Grounds... three days earlier than expected." Chen Ji tucked the Jade Pendant into his sleeve, expression unchanged, yet his mind was already rapidly calculating a new chess game.

The Top Eight draw ceremony began punctually at noon. Chen Ji stood in a corner, deliberately restraining his aura, appearing as just a Servant disciple come to watch. However, when the draw cylinder reached him, his hand was suddenly swept by a cold Spiritual Sense—that was a probing technique only possible at late Foundation Building stage. "Oh? So this is that废物?" A sinister voice rang out. Chen Ji looked up, meeting eyes glowing with eerie green light. The man wore Inner Disciple robes but carried a black token at his waist that did not belong to Tianqing Sect.

dialogue.content: "废物? Heh, if you were truly a废物, why would you be standing here?" The man leaned close to Chen Ji, lowering his voice, "Remember my name—Zhou Sha. A traitor expelled from the Inner Sect three months ago, now a honored guest of Xuanwu Sect. Today's competition—you'd better... be sensible."

text.content: After Zhou Sha finished speaking, he swept his sleeves and left, leaving behind a whiff of acrid Demonic Path aura. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, rapidly searching his mind for information on this person—Zhou Sha, formerly the third-ranked Inner Disciple, expelled three months ago for secretly communicating with the Demonic Path, yet somehow became an honored guest at Xuanwu Sect. His participation in this Sect Competition was clearly arranged by someone. "He's not here for kindness..." Chen Ji lowered his gaze, cold smile forming in his heart, "But since you've delivered yourself to my door, don't blame me for turning your scheme against you."

dialogue.content: The draw results were announced. On the Top Eight bracket, Chen Ji's name was赫然 positioned alongside Zhou Sha's. Surrounding whispers erupted: "That废物 has terrible luck, facing Xuanwu Sect's Zhou Sha in the first round!" "I heard Zhou Sha is already at Foundation Building Late Stage peak, this competition's championship favorite!" "Chen Ji's dead meat, won't survive three moves!" Chen Ji seemed not to hear these remarks, merely glancing calmly at Fifth Elder Ling Yuan on the high platform—whose lips seemed to carry an imperceptible smile.

text.content: At the third quarter hour past noon, the first Top Eight match officially began. The moment Chen Ji and Zhou Sha both leaped onto the Arena Platform, thunderous boos and cheers erupted from below. Zhou Sha stood with hands clasped behind his back, Foundation Building Late Stage pressure pouring forth like a mountain, enveloping Chen Ji. A mocking arc curved his lips: "废物, I'll give you one last chance. Kneel and concede now, and I might consider leaving you alive."

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to Zhou Sha's pressure and humiliation?

choices.description: Use his methods against him, returning Zhou Sha's mockery word-for-word, making him lose all face.
choices.visible_cost: Might provoke the opponent into even fiercer attacks
choices.visible_reward: Gain psychological initiative, the audience below will remember this insult
choices.risk_hint: The opponent's Combat Power far exceeds his own—provoking him may backfire
choices.process_label: 陈机冷笑着开口，声音不大，却清晰地传入每个人耳中。

dialogue.content: "Foundation Building Late Stage?" Chen Ji tilted his head, tone casual and dismissive, "So what? Three months ago, I clearly remember you kneeling at the Law Enforcement Hall door begging for mercy. Now you've changed your skin and forgotten who you are?"

text.content: The moment these words landed, the crowd below erupted. Zhou Sha's expression changed drastically, those eerie green eyes practically spitting fire: "You're courting death!" Spiritual Energy around him surged wildly, and he struck with a killing move from the start!

choices.description: Ignore Zhou Sha's taunts, silently circulate True Qi, prepare to counter forbidden techniques. Continue playing weak to eat the tiger.
choices.visible_cost: Might appear weak, potentially ridiculed by the audience
choices.visible_reward: Hide strength, let the opponent underestimate you
choices.risk_hint: Once forbidden techniques activate, there might be no time to react
choices.process_label: 陈机没有说话，只是缓缓抬起手中的木剑，摆出一个最简单的起手式。

text.content: Zhou Sha, seeing Chen Ji silent, assumed he was afraid. He sneered: "No words? Then go die!" His figure vanished abruptly, reappearing beside Chen Ji the next instant—one palm striking toward his Qi Sea Dantian—this was a killing move meant to cripple his cultivation!

choices.description: Knowing he's no match, better concede and exit the competition. The Forbidden Grounds opening is the real main storyline—no need to expose strength here.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all face, become a laughingstock
choices.visible_reward: Preserve hidden cards, secretly arrange布局
choices.risk_hint: Might affect standing and development within the Sect afterward
choices.process_label: 陈机微微叹了口气，似乎要开口认输。

text.content: However, at this moment Zhou Sha wouldn't give him a chance to speak—"废物, conceding won't help either!" His palm wind had already arrived, forcing Chen Ji to retreat. The Jade Pendant in his sleeve slipped out, hitting the ground with a crisp sound. "This Jade Pendant..." Zhou Sha's pupils contracted, as if recognizing something.

Zhou Sha's palm wind was razor-sharp, carrying诡异 black mist—the hallmark of Demonic Path forbidden techniques. Chen Ji dodged sideways, yet found his opponent's attacks shadowing him relentlessly, each strike precisely targeting his Qi Sea Dantian. "Forbidden Technique: Soul-Devouring Palm!" Zhou Sha roared, forming seals with both palms as a pulling force erupted violently, attempting to forcibly extract Chen Ji's True Qi!

Chen Ji felt his True Qi gushing out wildly, his meridians screaming with tearing pain. He wanted to break free, yet found his limbs bound by invisible chains, immobilized. "Hahaha! 废物, did you really think I came here just to compete?" Zhou Sha leaned close to his ear, voice lowered, "Someone wants me to—legitimately—cripple you right here."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, blood flowing down his lips. His vision gradually blurred, consciousness beginning to fade—yet at this critical moment, the Jade Pendant in his sleeve suddenly emitted dazzling golden light, resonating with some dormant bloodline within him! "Father..." Chen Ji's eyes blazed with golden light as磅礴 protective True Qi erupted from his Dantian depths!

text.content: BOOM—! A deafening dragon's roar resounded through the entire Martial Arena! Chen Ji's body erupted with a golden protective barrier, forcibly repelling Zhou Sha's Soul-Devouring Palm. That protective True Qi was vast as an ocean, carrying the pressure of an ancient divine beast, causing everyone present to change color! Zhou Sha was blasted flying several zhang, crashing into the Arena Platform's edge, vomiting blood.

dialogue.content: On the high platform, Fifth Elder Ling Yuan's previously calm expression instantly turned grave. He abruptly rose, his murky old eyes blazing with stunning light, staring fixedly at Chen Ji on the Arena Platform: "This aura... it's Chen Xuan's bloodline! Impossible, he's clearly just a废物..." Before he finished speaking, he suddenly realized his loss of composure, quickly restraining his aura and sitting back down. But all of this was witnessed by Su Qingyao nearby.

text.content: On the Arena Platform, Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet. His robes had been shattered by the True Qi, revealing his sturdy upper body—yet what drew the most attention was the faintly visible golden dragon pattern on his chest! That was the bloodline mark left by his father Chen Xuan, now radiating gentle light, merging with his True Qi.

choice.prompt: After bloodline awakening, how should Chen Ji act toward the shaken Zhou Sha?

choices.description: Utilize the awakened bloodline power to thoroughly defeat Zhou Sha, making him pay for his arrogance.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more strength, drawing attention from higher authorities
choices.visible_reward: Defeat a nemesis, shock the entire crowd, Reputation soaring
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is already suspicious—the more he exposes, the more dangerous
choices.process_label: 陈机嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，一步步向周煞走去。

text.content: "Just now you said you'd cripple my cultivation?" Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold and piercing, "Now it's my turn." He raised his hand and swept it down—a golden sword qi burst forth, directly targeting Zhou Sha! Zhou Sha was horrified, hastily summoning a protective spiritual artifact, yet it was shattered by a single strike!

choices.text: Stop at the appropriate point, preserve hidden cards
choices.description: Defeating Zhou Sha is enough, no need to kill. Give the opponent some face, keep a retreat path for yourself.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot fully suppress the opponent, may leave hidden dangers
choices.visible_reward: Won't be too shocking, reducing Ling Yuan's suspicion
choices.risk_hint: Zhou Sha may harbor grudges and seek revenge later
choices.process_label: 陈机停下脚步，负手而立，淡淡看着倒在地上的周煞。

dialogue.content: "Today's matter serves as a lesson for you." Chen Ji recalled his sword qi, tone light: "Get lost. Go tell your master—if they want to deal with me next time, send someone worthy." Zhou Sha's face turned ashen as he scrambled off the Arena Platform, not daring to stay another moment.

choices.text: Kill to silence, eliminate future troubles
choices.description: While Zhou Sha is severely injured, kill him directly! Dead men tell no tales—no one will know Chen Ji did it.
choices.visible_cost: Bears the sin of killing, may fall to Demonic Path; if discovered, reputation ruined
choices.visible_reward: Permanently eliminate hidden dangers, kill the chicken to frighten the monkeys, making behind-the-scenes forces hesitate
choices.risk_hint: The competition has elders supervising—acting may be discovered
choices.process_label: 陈机眼中闪过一丝杀意，手指微微动了动。

text.content: However, just as Chen Ji prepared to act, a fierce sword qi shot from the high platform, forcing him to retreat a step. "The match has been decided—no harming allowed!" Fifth Elder Ling Yuan's cold voice rang out, "Chen Ji, you win. Withdraw." Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, knowing he couldn't kill today. He could only clasp his fists: "Disciple obeys."

Chen Ji walked down the Arena Platform slowly, yet the gazes around him felt like thorns. He could sense countless Spiritual Senses sweeping over him—curiosity, shock, wariness, and—one chilling to the extreme killing intent. That came from above the high platform, from Fifth Elder Ling Yuan's direction. Chen Ji's expression remained normal, yet his heart was already churning: "Ling Yuan... indeed recognized father's bloodline mark. It seems the days ahead won't be peaceful."

At the edge of the Martial Arena, Su Qingyao stood quietly, the sword in her hand trembling slightly. She had witnessed Chen Ji's bloodline awakening firsthand—that golden protective True Qi, the faintly visible dragon pattern on his chest... "Chen Xuan's bloodline?" she murmured, her beautiful eyes flickering with complex emotions. How many more secrets did this废物 junior brother she had always investigated carry?

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." Su Qingyao blocked Chen Ji's path, her voice cold yet carrying an unnoticeable hint of concern, "That scene just now... you'd better give me an explanation." Chen Ji looked up at this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, corners of his mouth slightly rising: "What does Senior Sister Su wish to know?" Su Qingyao took a deep breath: "Who are you really? What is your relationship with Elder Chen Xuan?"

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's questioning, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao he truly is Chen Xuan's son, but don't mention core secrets like the Tianji Record. Try to win her trust.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his identity may draw more people to watch him
choices.visible_reward: Gain a certain degree of trust and protection from Su Qingyao
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may continue digging deeper, bringing more trouble
choices.process_label: 陈机沉默了片刻，然后缓缓开口，声音低沉。

dialogue.content: "Since Senior Sister Su asked, I won't hide it from you." Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of bitterness, "Chen Xuan... is my father. When he was expelled from the Sect twenty years ago, I was still in swaddling clothes. This Jade Pendant is the only legacy he left me."

text.content: Su Qingyao was stunned. She gazed at Chen Ji's deep eyes and suddenly realized this so-called废物 junior brother carried far heavier burdens than she'd imagined. "Regarding Elder Chen Xuan's matter... I'll help you investigate," she said softly, "But you must be careful of Ling Yuan."

choices.description: Continue maintaining the废物 persona, pretend to know nothing. Let Su Qingyao investigate on her own.
choices.visible_reward: Continue hiding strength, not drawing more attention
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is already suspicious, may investigate even more deeply
choices.process_label: 陈机露出一个无辜的笑容，双手一摆。

dialogue.content: "What is Senior Sister Su saying? Chen Xuan? I'm just a Servant disciple, how would I know about such things?" Chen Ji wore a look of confusion, "That protective True Qi earlier just appeared on its own—I don't know what happened either." Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly, clearly disbelieving: "You think I'm a fool?"

choices.text: Seize the initiative, warn her not to meddle
choices.description: Use words to warn Su Qingyao, letting her know some questions shouldn't be asked. Maintain an air of mystery.
choices.visible_cost: May offend Su Qingyao, affecting the relationship
choices.visible_reward: Make the other party retreat, no longer persisting
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's stubborn personality may backfire
choices.process_label: 陈机的神色忽然冷了下来，声音也变得淡漠。

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su, some things—knowing too much isn't good for you." Chen Ji's voice was low and ice-cold, "I'll advise you on this point—within this Sect, some muddy waters aren't something just anyone can wade through." Saying this, he walked past Su Qingyao without looking back.

text.content: The Top Eight competition continued, yet everyone's attention had shifted away from the matches themselves. Chen Ji's name spread through all of Tianqing Sect in just one hour—that废物 Servant disciple was said to possess ancient divine beast bloodline! The news spread like wildfire, even reaching ears of other Sect powers. Meanwhile, the echoes of those three bells from the Sect's depths still hadn't faded. The news of the Forbidden Grounds opening intertwined with rumors of Chen Ji's bloodline awakening, causing undercurrents to surge throughout Tianqing Sect.

Night fell. Chen Ji sat alone in the Servants' Quarters, the warm Jade Pendant clasped in his palm. Faint patterns emerged on the pendant's surface—seemingly some sealing formation—this was the final legacy his father left him. He closed his eyes, Mr. Mo's aged voice echoing in his mind: "First volume objective—enter the Top Eight in the Sect Competition, reveal your talent... completed."

dialogue.content: "Well done, well done." Mr. Mo's remnant soul drifted from the Jade Pendant, forming a faint light shadow, "You did better than I expected. The timing of your bloodline awakening was perfect—it intimidated the petty ones without fully exposing the Tianji Record's existence. However..." His tone suddenly grew grave, "Ling Yuan has set his sights on you. In the coming period, you must be even more careful."

text.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes, a gleam of light flashing in his gaze: "I know. But today's events weren't entirely bad news either." He stood and walked to the window, gazing toward the brightly lit direction of the Main Peak, "At the very least, now everyone knows there's a divine beast bloodline废物 disciple in Tianqing Sect. As for whether this废物 is playing weak to eat the tiger, or truly a废物... let them guess slowly."

Before he finished speaking, urgent footsteps suddenly came from outside the window. Chen Ji's expression changed slightly as he quickly tucked the Jade Pendant into his sleeve. The next moment, the door to the Servants' Quarters was pushed open. A disciple dressed in elder's robes stood at the entrance, expressionless: "Chen Ji, Fifth Elder requests your presence." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, yet wore that same weak, servile expression: "Yes, disciple will go immediately." In his heart, however, a cold laugh rang out: "Coming faster than I expected... Ling Yuan, Ling Yuan, what exactly do you want from me?"
